rows.jyutping: daai3 zyu6 waai4 nim6 ge3 sam1 cing4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to describe doing something nostalgically.

example.english: We nostalgically went back to the cha chaan teng we used to visit all the time.
example.traditional: 我哋帶住懷念嘅心情，行返以前成日去嗰間茶餐廳。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daai3 zyu6 waai4 nim6 ge3 sam1 cing4 haang4 faan2 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 heoi3 go2 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1
